title: Enabling GitHub Copilot and Copilot in Fabric
summary: Turn on AI-assisted development for SQL work and understand the security implications.

items: Enable GitHub Copilot and Copilot in Fabric.
Interpret the security impact of AI-assisted tools on SQL development.

blocks.body: AI-assisted tools speed up SQL development but can leak context or suggest insecure code — the exam tests both enablement and judgment.

terms.definition: AI pair-programmer that suggests code, including T-SQL, in editors like VS Code.
Microsoft Fabric's built-in AI assistance for data workloads.

blocks.body: Enable Copilot at the org/subscription level and in the editor. Understand that prompts and code context may be sent to the model; sensitive schema or data must be handled per policy. Always review AI-suggested SQL for injection risks and over-broad permissions.
Never paste secrets or production data into prompts. Treat generated SQL as a draft: verify object names, parameterization, and least-privilege before running.

tips: 'Security impact of AI-assisted tools' is an explicit skill — expect a judgment question.

blocks.body: Enable Copilot thoughtfully; review generated SQL for security, and keep sensitive data out of prompts.
